findings.source: PriceConfig.v2.sol requestPermissions: requests = new Permissions[](10); requests[0] = Permissions(PRICE_KEYCODE, PRICE.addAsset.selector); ... return requests;
findings.issue: Both implicit loops of this 10-element array (default allocation and ABI encoding) are rotated with the first element before the loop (P3), and the encoded values, all constants just stored, are re-read through memory, so the returned keycode/selector pairs are not visible in the return.
findings.rule: A loop with a constant trip count over values that are all known constants can be unrolled and folded; at least print a rotated loop with its first iteration merged back (do-while with a count n >= 1 is 'while idx < n' from 0).
